title: HTTP and API Development
purpose: Read requests, validate input, and test a real local API.
steps: Method, URL, headers, and JSON body
Reject invalid requests before changing state
Read or create the synthetic lesson
Inspect status, payload, and stored outcome
limit: Local in-memory API; not a production authentication or persistence system.

title: Git Collaboration and Code Review
purpose: Resolve a real conflict and undo a change without erasing shared history.
steps: Read both changes and their intended meaning
Resolve deliberately; inspect the staged diff
Verify history and rehearse a new revert commit
limit: Disposable local repository; no real PR, reviewer, remote, or push.

title: Databases and Safe Schema Changes
purpose: Practice constraints, transactions, compatible migration, and restoration.
steps: Start with real synthetic rows, not an empty schema
Add a compatible column and populate known data
A rejected related write rolls back the whole group
Check old schema and records, not just backup existence
limit: In-memory SQLite rehearsal; no production database migration.

title: Authentication, Authorization, and Secrets
purpose: Separate identity from resource access and field disclosure.
steps: The lab assumes a trusted server-side principal
Construct only the permitted synthetic output
Check exact fields and forbidden information absence
limit: Authorization fixture model only; login and token verification are not implemented.

title: Configuration and Environments
purpose: Parse settings deliberately and reject unsafe combinations.
steps: Text values are not yet validated settings
Recognize booleans, environment names, and URLs
Reject unsafe production settings before startup
Test the configuration without reading real secrets
limit: Synthetic settings; no cloud environment changes or network connectivity checks.

title: Background Jobs and Reliable Workflows
purpose: Understand retries, duplicate delivery, and transaction boundaries.
steps: Retries carry the same logical operation ID
Effect and receipt share one database transaction
Rollback on failure; persist both on success
A recorded completion prevents repeating this local effect
limit: Sequential database-local model; not exactly-once external execution.

title: Logging, Monitoring, and Incident Response
purpose: Trace synthetic failures and write an actionable incident response.
steps: Identify impact before guessing at the cause
Follow one request ID across component boundaries
Keep useful codes; exclude raw queries and tokens
Record the action, confirm recovery, and prevent recurrence
limit: Synthetic log model; no collector, dashboard, or live alert installed.

title: Docker and Local Environments
purpose: Build a small service image and reason about ports and storage.
steps: A small recipe copies only the application
Record the base reference and build outcome
Publish host loopback 4180 to container port 8080
Check health and logs; stop only the named lab container
limit: Docker unavailable here: image build and container run remain unverified.

title: Software Design and Refactoring
purpose: Extract responsibilities while preserving explicit behavior.
steps: Write explicit expected outputs before editing
Change structure without changing the contract
Verify the same outputs and review remaining gaps
limit: Three characterization cases; not exhaustive equivalence proof.

title: Accessible and Resilient Interfaces
purpose: Practice keyboard use, status feedback, failure, and retry.
steps: Use a labeled control and explain the proposed action
Show progress and prevent repeated local submission
Explain recovery or confirm the simulated outcome
Check keyboard flow, focus, status, and repeated clicks
limit: Browser-only simulation; no real operation or complete accessibility audit.

title: Performance Investigation
purpose: Measure query behavior and verify correctness after indexing.
steps: Same synthetic rows, query, and environment
Inspect plan and repeated observed timings
Add an index for the selected query
Check equal results, new plan, and measured timing
limit: Local synthetic query measurements; no promised production speedup.

title: Reading an Unfamiliar Codebase
purpose: Trace a feature, establish a baseline, and plan a small first change.
steps: Read the invocation and the user's intended behavior
Trace published-only filtering and query matching
Inspect fixtures and establish passing baseline evidence
Add a whitespace regression test before editing behavior
limit: Tiny teaching repository; the final whitespace enhancement is unsolved.
